BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-60-2.constraint: Use '=' as separator between Account Number and Card Discretionary Block Data

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-60-3.statement: For Track 1 credit cards, Account Number is data before first '^' and remainder is Card Discretionary Block Data.
BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-60-3.condition: Account Number obtained from Track 1 card reader (credit cards only)
BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-60-3.constraint: Use '^' as separator between Account Number and Card Discretionary Block Data

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-60-4.statement: Account Number and Card Discretionary Block Data combined do not exceed 76 characters for Track 1.

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-60-5.statement: Account Number and Card Discretionary Block Data combined do not exceed 37 characters for Track 2.

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-70-1.statement: For financial transactions, Response Code identifies approval with purchase/capture, approval without purchase/capture, or decline.
BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-70-1.constraint: Response Code indicates approval w/ capture, approval w/o capture, or decline

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-76-2.statement: In a preauthorized transaction, Sequence Number in Purchase/Capture equals the Sequence Number in the Authorization Only request.
BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-76-2.constraint: Sequence Number = original Authorization Only Sequence Number

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-76-5.statement: Authorization Only Reversal applies to POS Authorization Only (3), POS Mail/Phone Authorization Only (B), and CAT Authorization Only (5).
BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-76-5.constraint: Applies only to Transaction Type codes 3, B, 5

BR-BUYPASS-IIN-9-5.statement: Visa, MasterCard, and Discover will implement the change from six-digit to eight-digit issuing BINs to align with ISO standard.
BR-BUYPASS-IIN-9-5.constraint: Issuing BIN length changes from 6 to 8 digits

BR-BUYPASS-INCOMM-MBD-11-1.statement: Adjustment to Price is not provided on a 310 message because it is a preauthorization.

BR-BUYPASS-INCOMM-MBD-4-4.statement: Transaction Type value 200 means Limited Spend Refund.

BR-BUYPASS-INCOMM-MBD-6-2.statement: The PI dataset is required when evaluation of the market basket must be completed by IH to authorize a discount, payment, or refund.
BR-BUYPASS-INCOMM-MBD-6-2.condition: Evaluation of the market basket must be completed by IH to authorize a discount, payment, or refund

BR-BUYPASS-INCOMM-MBD-6-3.statement: PI dataset required when evaluation of market basket must be completed by IH to authorize a discount, payment, or refund.
BR-BUYPASS-INCOMM-MBD-6-3.condition: IH must evaluate market basket for discount/payment/refund

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-13-2.statement: Chapter 3 discusses transaction requirements for POS and CAT Authorization Only, Purchase/Capture, Return/Refund, Reversal/Void, and Time-out Reversal.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-140-4.statement: Only POS Authorization Only Transaction is supported for Money Code processing.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-140-4.constraint: transaction type limited to POS Authorization Only

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-147-2.statement: WEX swiped offline mode: only fuel products allowed if Purchase Restriction = 00.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-147-2.condition: WEX card, Swiped, offline mode, Purchase Restriction = 00

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-147-3.statement: WEX swiped: all products allowed if Purchase Restriction is any value other than 00.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-147-4.statement: WEX keyed entry: if a Prompt Code appears on front of card, enter the Prompt Code for Driver ID; else prompt for Driver ID.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-147-4.constraint: Enter Prompt Code if present, else prompt Driver ID (max 10 digits)

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-147-5.statement: WEX keyed entry: if a Prompt Code appears on front of card, enter it for Odometer; else prompt for Odometer Reading.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-147-5.constraint: Enter Prompt Code if present, else prompt Odometer Reading (max 9 digits)

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-147-6.statement: WEX keyed entry: always prompt for Vehicle ID, value is 8 digits embossed on front of card.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-147-6.constraint: Vehicle ID = 8 digits embossed on card

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-147-7.statement: WEX keyed entry: attendant must validate purchase restrictions on card against products being purchased.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-16-10.statement: Controller/device should allow configuration of preauthorization amounts.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-173-1.statement: If terminal finds values not included in this table, it should prompt for Driver ID and Odometer.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-173-1.condition: WEX Track 2 Field 6/Field 10 value not in table
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-173-1.constraint: Prompt for Driver ID and Odometer

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-173-3.statement: POS and CAT terminals use fields 6 and 10 of WEX card Track 2 data to determine customer prompting.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-173-3.constraint: Determine prompts from Track 2 fields 6 and 10

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-174-2.statement: Vehicle ID is a new prompt value, distinct from the Vehicle Card Number in Track 2 or embossed on the card.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-174-2.constraint: Vehicle ID prompt must not be confused with Vehicle Card Number

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-18-9.statement: CAT Purchase/Completion transaction must be transmitted from device no later than 55 minutes after creation by controller.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-18-9.condition: Petroleum credit card CAT Purchase/Completion transaction
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-18-9.constraint: Must transmit within 55 minutes of creation

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-20-2.statement: CAT Authorization Only Request format must indicate a customer-activated device initiated the transaction.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-20-2.constraint: Format must indicate customer-activated device origin

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-20-3.statement: Controller supplies anticipated fuel type and price per gallon, required for fuel limits and fuel-only card validation.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-20-3.constraint: Fuel type and price per gallon required

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-20-4.statement: If approval received, device signals AFP system to dispense fuel up to preapproved Preauthorization amount.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-20-4.constraint: Dispense fuel up to preauthorization amount

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-23-1.statement: POS Authorization Only transaction verifies fund availability and authorizes purchase for specific dollar amount.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-23-1.constraint: Authorizes purchase for specific dollar amount

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-23-3.statement: Prepay transaction uses a POS Capture transaction to complete once fueling is finished.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-23-6.statement: No receipt is required for a POS Authorization Only transaction.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-23-7.statement: POS Authorization Only transaction does not use address verification.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-24-5.statement: Capture of POS authorization only is dependent upon a prior Authorization Only transaction.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-24-6.statement: A receipt is printed for POS Authorization Only transaction for the specific dollar amount.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-24-6.constraint: Print receipt for specific dollar amount

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-24-7.statement: If actual purchase amount differs from Authorization Only receipt amount, a second receipt is printed for POS Capture transaction's actual amount.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-24-7.condition: Actual purchase amount differs from Authorization Only receipt amount
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-24-7.constraint: Print additional receipt for actual dollar amount

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-27-12.statement: Valid credit card payment methods include American Express, MasterCard, Discover Network, Visa.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-27-12.constraint: Accepted card brands: Amex, MasterCard, Discover, Visa

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-27-3.statement: AVS is required at the CAT for CAT Authorization Only transactions for outside transactions.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-27-8.statement: Authorization Response must approve both the Authorization Only amount and AVS zip code to activate pump.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-27-8.constraint: Both approval and positive AVS response required

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-27-9.statement: Any negative or no response on AVS zip code cancels transaction and directs customer inside as POS Purchase/Capture.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-28-1.statement: Final total purchase amount cannot exceed the authorized amount in the completed CAT Authorization Only transaction.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-28-1.constraint: Final total purchase amount <= authorized amount

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-28-7.statement: This transaction does not use address verification.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-29-2.statement: POS Return/Refund transaction returns or refunds all or part of a previously processed Purchase transaction.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-29-2.constraint: Only refunds previously processed Purchase transactions.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-29-3.statement: POS Return/Refund transaction involves no other transactions.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-29-4.statement: POS Return/Refund is initiated when cardholder returns item purchased on a previous business day.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-29-4.condition: Cardholder returns item purchased previous business day

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-29-7.statement: A receipt must be printed for POS Return/Refund transaction.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-29-8.statement: Address verification is not used with a POS Return/Refund transaction.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-30-2.statement: POS Reversal/Void transaction depends on a prior POS Purchase Capture transaction.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-30-2.constraint: requires prior POS Purchase Capture transaction

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-30-3.statement: If POS Reversal/Void transaction is declined, a POS Return/Refund transaction needs to be performed.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-100-5.statement: Return and Refund Policies terms and conditions are mandatory on receipt.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-100-5.constraint: Must display merchant terms and conditions

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-100-9.statement: For transactions declined offline without online authorization, mandatory EMV tags AID, TVR, IAD, and ARC with values must be printed.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-100-9.condition: Transaction declined offline without going online for authorization
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-100-9.constraint: Must include AID, TVR, IAD, ARC labels and tag values

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-101-9.statement: Card Entry Method must be printed: 'Chip Read' for inserted, 'Contactless' for contactless, 'FSwipe' for fallback.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-102-2.statement: Refund policy must be clearly printed on paper or email receipt in face-to-face environment per Mastercard No Signature requirement.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-102-2.constraint: Refund policy must be printed on receipt

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-103-4.statement: RQ 6700: Offline Decline EMV receipt data is required on all offline decline receipts regardless of card scheme.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-103-4.constraint: EMV receipt data required for all card brands

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-103-5.statement: Offline Decline EMV data fields must be printed in the order shown in the table and identified by the defined label.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-103-5.constraint: Fields printed in table order with Receipt Text/Description labels

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-105-7.statement: AID, Brand Name, Application Label, and Transaction Date Source are mandatory across all listed card brands.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-107-1.statement: EMV tags that must be printed on chip offline decline receipts.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-107-1.constraint: printed on chip offline decline receipts

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-107-4.statement: Chip offline decline receipts must print minimum EMV tags: 50, 5F2A, 5F34, 82, 95, 9A, 9C, 9F02, 9F03
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-107-4.constraint: Minimum required tags per Fiserv must be printed

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-108-1.statement: EMV receipt data for RQ 09000 Offline Decline must be kept at least six months or until batch settlement.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-108-1.constraint: EMV receipt data must be kept at least six months or until batch settlement is performed

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-108-2.statement: RQ 09100 Offline Decline requires EMV receipt data for all card brands.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-108-2.constraint: EMV receipt data required for all card brands

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-111-1.statement: EMV POS Solution should include a Chip Transaction Report printing EMV data element values.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-111-1.constraint: Report available at minimum for last transaction processed, approved or declined.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-111-3.statement: EMV POS Solution should include Clerk Fallback Report and PIN Pad Fallback Report to monitor Fallback percentages.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-111-3.constraint: Two fallback reports recommended: Clerk and PIN Pad.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-111-4.statement: Fallback identified when card service code starts with 2xx or 6xx but magnetic stripe used instead of chip.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-111-4.constraint: Magnetic stripe data used instead of chip indicates Fallback transaction.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-111-5.statement: High Fallback rates may indicate need for training, possible fraud, or equipment malfunction.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-111-5.constraint: Investigate clerk training, fraud, or equipment issues when Fallback rate high.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-112-1.statement: PIN Pad Fallback Report identifies fallback transaction percentage per PIN Pad to find hardware needing servicing.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-112-1.constraint: Report can show all PIN Pads or only those exceeding a threshold fallback percentage.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-113-2.statement: EMV Configuration Report is mandatory in all EMV POS Solutions.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-114-1.statement: An EMV Configuration Report is mandatory and must be available on all EMV POS Solutions
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-114-1.constraint: EMV Configuration Report must be accessible for dispute research or audit request

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-114-2.statement: Failure to provide EMV Configuration Report during certification may delay a project
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-114-2.condition: Failure to provide report during certification

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-115-15.statement: Terminal Floor Limit (EMV) (9F1B) recommended value is 0.00

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-115-16.statement: EMV Random Selection Threshold recommended value is 0.00

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-115-17.statement: EMV Random Selection Maximum % recommended value is 99

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-115-18.statement: EMV Random Selection Target % recommended value is 99

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-115-20.statement: Allow Fallback Flag recommended value is Y/N

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-118-3.statement: EMV tag acceptance or transmission must not be hard-coded as tag requirements may change at any time.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-118-3.constraint: Do not hard-code tag acceptance/transmission logic

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-119-1.statement: Tag 9F53 is required for Mastercard Credit and optional for Mastercard Debit AID.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-119-1.constraint: Tag 9F53 required; optional for Mastercard Debit AID

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-120-1.statement: Tag 9F6E must be Upper Case for alpha values; consult Mastercard/Visa docs for valid Form Factor values; do not send if invalid.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-120-1.constraint: Use Upper Case, valid Form Factor values only; omit if invalid

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-120-10.statement: All authorization request messages should contain all EMV tags regardless of transaction type or card used.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-120-4.statement: Tag 9F0A is a new optional tag for Mastercard.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-120-9.statement: Do not hard code acceptance or transmission of EMV tags since viable tags are subject to change.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-120-9.constraint: Allow dynamic handling of EMV tags

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-121-2.statement: Track 1 Data may be present during a Mastercard Contactless - Mag Stripe transaction with modified discretionary data.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-121-2.constraint: Reader copies UN, CVC3, ATC into discretionary data field and stores modified Track 1 Data

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-122-2.statement: Template '70' is mandatory for SFIs 1-10; response messages for SFIs 11-30 are outside EMV scope but may use template '70'.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-128-2.statement: ATC (9F36) is maintained by the application in the ICC, with incrementing managed by the ICC.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-130-1.statement: ICC Offline Accumulator Balance 2 is retrieved by GET DATA command if allowed by the application.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-130-2.statement: ICC Offline Counterbalance 2 is retrieved by GET DATA command if allowed by the application.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-132-2.statement: If MSD offset personalized with value greater than zero, dCVV and ATC calculated and inserted into Track 2 Equivalent Data for MSD transactions.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-132-2.constraint: dCVV and ATC inserted into Track 2 Equivalent Data

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-132-3.statement: If MSD offset not personalized or zero, Track 2 Equivalent Data returned exactly as personalized.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-132-4.statement: Bit 8 of MSD offset: 1 = insert ATC into Track 2 Equivalent Data for all qVSDC and MSD transactions.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-132-4.constraint: Insert ATC into Track 2 Equivalent Data for all qVSDC/MSD transactions

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-132-5.statement: Bit 8 of MSD offset: 0 = offset from beginning of Track 2 Equivalent Data to first digit of CVV placeholder.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-132-5.constraint: Offset indicates first digit of CVV placeholder

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-134-1.statement: If a given EMV tag is present on the card, it must be present in the authorization message.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-134-1.constraint: Tag must be present in authorization message

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-136-3.statement: DDCARD TRACK1 contains discretionary data copy from Track 1 only if Track 1 Data is present.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-136-3.constraint: DDCARD TRACK1 populated from READ RECORD during Mastercard Contactless - Mag Stripe transaction

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-138-1.statement: Approved outcome: MasterCard Contactless reader is satisfied transaction is acceptable and wants offline approval.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-138-4.statement: Try Another Interface outcome: reader unable to complete transaction but another interface may be available.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-138-4.constraint: Terminal may attempt contact or magnetic-stripe interface

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-140-1.statement: EMV POS Solutions supporting DDA must have a Default DDOL containing only Unpredictable Number (Tag 9F37)
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-140-1.constraint: Default DDOL must contain only Unpredictable Number (Tag 9F37)

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-141-1.statement: If EMV POS Solution supports a Default TDOL for MasterCard, it must contain only Tags 9F02, 5F2A, 9A, 9C, 95, 9F37.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-141-1.condition: EMV POS Solution supports Default TDOL for MasterCard
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-141-1.constraint: Must contain Transaction Amount, Currency Code, Transaction Date, Transaction Type, TVR Results, Unpredictable Number only

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-142-2.statement: If fallback not allowed, print Declined receipt and transaction is unsuccessful.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-142-3.statement: If fallback allowed, process as non-EMV transaction.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-142-4.statement: EMV flow: Application Selection, Build AID Candidate List, check IIN Tag 42 presence in Candidate List.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-142-4.constraint: IIN Tag 42 must be present in Candidate List or processing fails

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-142-9.statement: On approval, store transaction with EMV data saved, then print Approved receipt; transaction successful.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-142-9.constraint: Store Transaction, Print Approved Receipt, Transaction Successful

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-143-3.statement: Some cards do not support EXTERNAL AUTHENTICATE; ARPC is validated during 2nd Generate AC processing instead.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-143-3.condition: Card does not support EXTERNAL AUTHENTICATE
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-143-3.constraint: ARPC validated as part of 2nd Generate AC, managed by EMV kernel

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-143-7.statement: TACs are three data elements set by the card scheme and loaded as parameters by the EMV POS Solution, mirroring TVR bits.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-143-7.constraint: TAC bits correspond to TVR bits

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-151-2.statement: Terminal Capabilities Tag 9F33 Byte 2 defines CVM capability bits
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-151-2.constraint: Bits indicate Plain text PIN ICC, Enciphered PIN online, Signature, Enciphered PIN offline, NO CVM; remaining reserved

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-152-10.statement: Mastercard removed requirement for AFD terminals to set CVM limit to USD 0 for all AIDs in U.S.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-152-10.condition: Automated fuel dispenser (AFD) terminals in U.S. region
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-152-10.constraint: CVM limit no longer required to be USD 0

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-152-5.statement: Mastercard Credit AID above CVM limit supports Online PIN and Signature, 9F33 Byte 2 value is 60.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-152-5.condition: Mastercard Credit (A0000000041010), transaction above CVM limit

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-152-8.statement: No CVM 08 value below CVM limit applies only to Mastercard Credit and US Maestro.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-152-8.condition: Mastercard Credit (A0000000041010) or US Maestro (A0000000042203), below CVM limit

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-153-1.statement: Mastercard only supports CDA as the Security Capability for contactless transactions.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-153-2.statement: All three Mastercard AIDs contactless transactions must have 9F33 Byte 3 value set to '08' for CDA-only support.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-153-3.statement: CDA must always be supported (LOA2 must be 'Yes') if valid for EMV Certification.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-154-2.statement: Byte 2 values driven by EMV Contactless CVM Limits per terminal kernel configuration.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-156-14.statement: Bit b6=1 means ICC data missing.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-157-1.statement: TVR Byte 2 bit b8 set means ICC and terminal have different application versions.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-161-11.statement: EMV AID must be printed on receipt below account number, labeled AID.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-161-12.statement: Card Entry Method shows 'Chip Read' when card inserted and read via contact chip.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-161-12.condition: Card inserted and read via chip

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-161-3.statement: Merchant Number (MID) and Terminal ID (TID) should be masked on EMV receipt.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-161-3.constraint: MID and TID must be masked

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-162-2.statement: Fallback swipe transaction requires a signature line to be printed on receipt.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-162-2.condition: Card entry via fallback swipe (chip read error)

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-163-11.statement: EMV AID must be printed on receipt identified by tag name AID.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-163-12.statement: EMV Information must be printed in order shown and identified by tag names.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-163-12.constraint: Print in specified order with tag labels

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-163-14.statement: EMV Offline Data block (Tag 50, Tag 5F2A, etc.) printed in order shown using labels shown.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-163-14.constraint: Print tags in specified order with labels

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-163-7.statement: Card Entry Method must indicate chip read when card inserted and chip data obtained.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-163-7.condition: Card inserted and info obtained via chip

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-169-3.statement: POS terminals must use the MasterCard Certificate Authority (CA) Keys for the Voyager AID.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-169-3.constraint: Use MasterCard CA Keys for Voyager AID

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-169-6.statement: Terminals that support Voyager must always process the card using the Voyager application, prioritized over Mastercard Credit application.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-169-6.condition: Card has Dual AID (Voyager and Mastercard Credit)

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-172-3.statement: If service code begins with '2' or '6', terminal prompts cardholder to insert chip card.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-172-3.condition: EMV card swiped first and first Service Code digit is '2' or '6'
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-172-3.constraint: Terminal prompts cardholder to insert card to force chip use

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-173-2.statement: If track position starts with '2' or '6', terminal must request cardholder insert card into chip reader.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-173-2.constraint: Terminal must request chip card insertion

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-173-3.statement: New value for 'Truck Class' included in Track 1 Position 63 and Track 2 Position 36.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-173-3.constraint: Truck Class value added at Track 1 pos 63, Track 2 pos 36

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-175-4.statement: Fuelman EMV transactions will be processed only as Dual message.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-176-1.statement: Fuelman card ICC public keys are signed under Mastercard Certification Authority Keys.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-176-1.constraint: ICC public keys signed under Mastercard Certification Authority Keys

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-176-4.statement: Fuelman EMV cards will not include an ARPC in authorization responses.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-176-4.constraint: No ARPC; AIP indicates issuer authentication not supported

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-178-3.statement: Sunoco PLCC cards are strictly credit cards using Mastercard RID (A000000004) and follow M/Chip requirements.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-178-3.constraint: Must use Mastercard RID A000000004 and M/Chip rules

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-179-6.statement: Only specific EMV sub-elements are expected which will meet the 255-field length

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-183-4.statement: The ARPC is generated by the issuer in response to the ARQC and sent to the ICC in the authorization response message.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-183-4.constraint: ICC validates ARPC to confirm response came from true card issuer

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-183-5.statement: The ARQC is generated by the ICC in response to the FIRST GENERATE AC command when the transaction requires online authorization.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-183-5.constraint: ICC generates ARQC sent to issuer for authentication

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-195-2.statement: PSE is optional in EMV but highly recommended to enhance transaction performance.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-199-2.statement: TC (Transaction Certificate) is generated only when the ICC wishes to approve the transaction.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-199-3.statement: TDOL is used to generate TC Hash Value; default TDOL should exist in CAD if not present in ICC.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-199-3.constraint: CAD must use payment system default TDOL

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-199-4.statement: Technical Fallback uses magnetic stripe reader if ICC or EMV PIN Pad is inoperable.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-199-4.condition: ICC or EMV PIN Pad inoperable
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-199-4.constraint: use magnetic stripe reader to obtain card information

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-209-8.statement: POS terminals must use the MasterCard Certificate Authority (CA) Keys for the Voyager AID

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-209-9.statement: Not all AID Tags are needed to populate EMV transactions
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-209-9.constraint: Some AID Tags optional for EMV transaction population

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-24-1.statement: EMV L3 certifications are performed for the US Region only, applying to locations using the USA country code.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-24-1.constraint: L3 certification applies to US Region only

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-26-1.statement: EMV POS Solutions must be EMV Level 1 and Level 2 type approved and PCI PTS approved.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-26-1.constraint: POS Solution must have EMV and PCI PTS approvals

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-26-5.statement: POS Solutions must have ability to produce an EMV Configuration Report in readable format.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-26-5.constraint: EMV Configuration Report must be producible in readable format

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-26-7.statement: EMV 3DS 2.0 transactions are not EMV transactions as described in this document.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-27-1.statement: Clients that choose to support MSR contactless must support EMV contactless.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-27-2.statement: If an EMV solution supports MSR contactless then it must support EMV contactless mode.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-29-1.statement: Applicable features must be MSR certified before being EMV certified
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-29-1.constraint: Feature must be MSR certified first, then EMV certified

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-33-3.statement: If EMV POS Solution supports more than one kernel configuration, multiple card brand certifications required if device not in same family.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-33-7.statement: Fiserv requires full certification of EMV contact, contactless, magnetic stripe transactions and a pilot before production approval.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-33-7.constraint: Full certification plus pilot required before production

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-34-1.statement: Do not perform Card Brand Certification until confident the EMV POS Solution will pass all test cases.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-34-1.constraint: EMV POS Solution must be ready before Card Brand Certification

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-34-2.statement: Fiserv must be notified of all kernel configurations used by the EMV POS Solution, documented in the SOW.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-34-2.constraint: All kernel configurations must be documented in the SOW

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-34-3.statement: Developer must provide EMVCo Level 1 and Level 2 type approval, PCI PTS (if applicable), and Mastercard TQM before certification project begins.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-34-3.constraint: Must obtain EMVCo L1/L2, PCI PTS (if applicable), Mastercard TQM

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-36-1.statement: A connectivity test is scheduled to ensure EMV POS Solution can communicate with t3: Cert platform via Fiserv host connection.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-36-1.constraint: Connectivity test must occur before further testing

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-36-3.statement: Clients must provide EMV Configuration report prior to Test Certify; fixes must be completed before Implementation for any failed test cases.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-36-3.constraint: All fixes completed until test cases pass or are covered by waivers

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-36-6.statement: To move to Implementation Phase, client must report Test Certify finished and all test cases passed or waived, with final EMV Configuration report provided.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-36-6.constraint: Must submit final EMV Configuration report and pass/waive all tests

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-37-1.statement: Implementation Phase must include all Fiserv EMV test cases and EMV brand certification test cases from t3:Cert Test Plan.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-37-1.constraint: All test cases must be included before phase completion

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-37-10.statement: If Go-Live testing fails, developer must modify EMV POS Solution failover processing and Go-Live testing is redone.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-37-10.constraint: Modify failover processing; redo Go-Live testing

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-37-9.statement: Prior to Go-Live, EMV POS Solution must use production Merchant ID and Terminal ID, connect to production Fiserv host, load production CAPK keys, print EMV Configuration Report.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-38-1.statement: At minimum the pilot must include at least one full settlement period with no issues.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-38-1.constraint: At least one full settlement period with no issues required

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-38-6.statement: Example: terminal certified for Mastercard and Visa adding Amex and Discover requires certification only of Amex and Discover.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-38-6.condition: Adding American Express and Discover to terminal certified for Mastercard/Visa
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-38-6.constraint: Certification required only for new brands, not MC/Visa

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-39-5.statement: Regardless of Major or Minor change, regression testing should be performed with Fiserv for EMV and MSR functionality.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-39-6.statement: Recertification to a Brand(s) would require regression for MSR and EMV where applicable.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-39-6.constraint: Regression for MSR and EMV where applicable

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-39-8.statement: Clients are expected to perform an EMV Go Live Test before accepting full production traffic.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-39-8.constraint: EMV Go Live Test must be performed

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-39-9.statement: EMV payment coding cannot be modified post certification; UAT should not be used for testing such changes.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-39-9.constraint: UAT not used to test EMV payment coding changes

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-4-2.statement: EMV L3 certifications are performed for the US Region only, applicable to USA country code locations.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-4-2.constraint: L3 certification performed for US Region only

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-40-1.statement: Fiserv will only require the developer to execute test cases using an EMV Test Tool.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-40-1.constraint: Developer must execute test cases using EMV Test Tool.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-40-3.statement: EMV Test Plastics are available for purchase through 3rd party vendor B2 for use with a generic test script.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-40-3.constraint: Use generic test script with EMV Test Plastics.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-42-1.statement: Card Insertion or Tap must be attempted first for all EMV chip cards.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-42-1.constraint: Insertion or tap must be attempted first

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-42-2.statement: Card swipe is only allowed for EMV cards when in fallback.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-42-3.statement: If Service Code indicates chip, swipe read data must be discarded and insert/tap prompt displayed.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-42-4.statement: RQ 0900: Service Code '2xx' and '6xx' must force a chip usage; prompt for chip reader insertion.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-42-4.constraint: EMV POS Solution must prompt for card insertion into chip reader

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-43-1.statement: The EMV POS Solution must be configured with the AIDs of all the chip payment applications it supports.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-43-1.constraint: configured with the AIDs of all the chip payment applications it supports

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-43-3.statement: US Terminals must not include Canadian ASF logic for Interac Co-Badged cards.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-43-3.condition: Canadian-issued co-badged card used at US terminal
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-43-3.constraint: Terminal must not default to Interac via ASF, to avoid fallback/fraud

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-43-4.statement: If no supported AID matches the card, a chip transaction cannot be performed and fallback rules must be followed.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-43-4.condition: No matching AID between EMV POS Solution and card
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-43-4.constraint: Fallback processing rules must be followed

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-43-5.statement: Full Selection requires exact match of entire card AID including issuer suffix.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-43-5.constraint: EMV POS AID must exactly match entire card AID

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-45-1.statement: AIDs not approved for use must be ignored by EMV POS Solution and not sent to host for authorization.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-45-1.constraint: Must be ignored, not sent to host for authorization

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-46-1.statement: A default application name should be assigned for all AIDs supported by the EMV POS Solution.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-46-1.condition: Application Preferred Name and Application Label not present or cannot be used
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-46-1.constraint: Display default application name assigned to the AID

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-49-2.statement: If PIN supported by device, both Online and Offline PIN must be supported
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-49-2.condition: POS device supports PIN for magnetic stripe swipe transactions
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-49-2.constraint: Must support both online and offline PIN for any message type

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-49-5.statement: Newly deployed Mastercard unattended POS terminals must not support Offline Plaintext PIN from January 1, 2025
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-49-5.condition: Newly deployed unattended POS terminal on/after Jan 1 2025
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-49-5.constraint: Must not support Offline Plaintext PIN

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-49-6.statement: Newly deployed Mastercard attended POS terminals must not support Offline Plaintext PIN from June 1, 2027
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-49-6.condition: Newly deployed attended POS terminal on/after June 1 2027
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-49-6.constraint: Must not support Offline Plaintext PIN

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-49-7.statement: Signature CVM must still be supported for all attended EMV POS Solutions certified by Fiserv
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-49-7.condition: Attended EMV POS Solution certified by Fiserv

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-51-12.statement: EMV POS Solutions do not need to support a Hot Card list (terminal exception file).

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-51-5.statement: PIN Bypass is not allowed on Mastercard CAT and Contactless transactions.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-51-6.statement: PIN Bypass is allowed on AFDs in US region per Mastercard M/Chip Requirements document.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-52-1.statement: All EMV POS Solutions must support EMV Terminal Risk Management regardless of terminal's offline capabilities.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-52-1.constraint: EMV Terminal Risk Management features must be supported

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-52-3.statement: Tag 9A (Transaction Date) must be the actual date the cardholder used their EMV card at the POS when creating the ARQC.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-52-3.constraint: Tag 9A value must equal actual transaction date

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-53-1.statement: RQ 2500: EMV POS Solution must not use kernel force online feature to force transactions online.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-53-1.constraint: Must not enable/use kernel force online feature; would set TVR Merchant Forced Online bit (Byte-4 bit-4)

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-54-9.statement: AID and CVM negotiation takes place before any BIN range checking for EMV transactions.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-54-9.constraint: BIN Range validation for PIN prompting is out of scope; negotiated AID/CVM determines processing

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-55-12.statement: Offline Approved ICC decision (Y1) maps to Tag 8A hex 0x5931.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-55-13.statement: Offline Declined ICC decision (Z1) maps to Tag 8A hex 0x5A31.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-55-14.statement: Unable to go online, Offline approve (Y3) maps to Tag 8A hex 0x5933.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-55-14.condition: ICC/Chip Decision = Unable to go online: Offline approve (Y3)

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-55-15.statement: Unable to go online, Offline Decline (Z3) maps to Tag 8A hex 0x5A33.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-55-15.condition: ICC/Chip Decision = Unable to go online: Offline Decline (Z3)

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-56-10.statement: Send offline approved transaction (TC and EMV data) to host prior to or at settlement.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-56-10.constraint: Send to host prior to or at settlement

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-56-14.statement: Not all card schemes or issuers support Offline Approval; Fiserv currently only supports Mastercard Offline Processing.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-56-3.statement: If Issuer Response Code (Tag 8A) absent, EMV POS must interpret host response and set Tag 8A before 2nd Generate AC.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-56-3.condition: Issuer Response Code (Tag 8A) not present in host authorization response
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-56-3.constraint: EMV POS Solution must set Tag 8A to approved/declined before 2nd Generate AC

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-56-4.statement: EMV POS Solution must support extracting Issuer Scripts (Tag 71 or 72) and forwarding to EMV kernel.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-56-4.condition: Host returns Issuer Script in authorization response
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-56-4.constraint: Must extract and forward script to EMV kernel for execution

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-56-8.statement: When offline approved, EMV POS Solution should set Authorization Response Code (Tag 8A) to 'Y1'.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-56-8.condition: Transaction offline approved by card without host authorization

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-57-2.statement: Some cards validate ARPC during 2nd Generate AC instead of using EXTERNAL AUTHENTICATE.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-57-2.condition: Card does not support EXTERNAL AUTHENTICATE
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-57-2.constraint: ARPC validated via EMV kernel during 2nd Generate AC

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-58-11.statement: RQ 3100: EMV POS Solution must support Issuer Scripts up to 128 bytes in length.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-58-11.constraint: Max supported Issuer Script length is 128 bytes

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-59-1.statement: EMV POS Solutions must be able to reverse an EMV transaction if the card provides an AAC cryptogram even if issuer approved.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-59-1.condition: Card provides AAC cryptogram after issuer approval

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-59-4.statement: Recommended: sound an audible beep while waiting for the EMV card to be removed.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-61-1.statement: Balance inquiry transactions do not transfer funds and therefore should not be reversed.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-61-4.statement: Balance Inquiries on EMV card profiles are a function of Tag 9F40 (Additional Terminal Capabilities).

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-62-6.statement: Cashback amount must be populated in EMV tags and known/used prior to generating the cryptogram.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-62-6.constraint: Cashback amount known before cryptogram generation

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-63-1.statement: Effective 10/14/17, Mastercard raised the Contactless CVM limit from $50 to $100.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-63-4.statement: JCB EMV Contactless is now supported.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-63-6.statement: It is recommended that EMV POS support same key functionality for all Brands in scope to avoid Brand favoritism.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-63-6.constraint: Support contactless for all accepted Brands

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-63-7.statement: RQ 3800: Any POS device that supports MSR contactless must support EMV contactless.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-63-8.statement: RQ 3900: EMV Contactless devices must support the latest Payment Network specifications.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-63-8.constraint: must support latest Payment Network specifications

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-64-1.statement: Form Factor/Device Type Indicator (Tag 9F6E) must be supplied for MSR and EMV contactless transactions, if present on card.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-64-1.constraint: Tag 9F6E must be supplied if present on card

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-64-2.statement: MSR Contactless transactions no longer require Device Type Indicator per recent Mastercard change.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-65-1.statement: EMV contactless devices must support CDCVM for all Payment Networks.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-65-1.constraint: All EMV contactless capable devices must support Consumer Device Cardholder Verification Method for all payment networks.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-66-5.statement: DCC supported for EMV transactions if currency selected before 1st Generate AC and host request reflects chosen currency.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-66-5.constraint: Currency selected before 1st GEN AC and reflected in host request

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-67-2.statement: If Global Credit AID selected for Visa/Mastercard, determine DCC eligibility.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-67-2.condition: Global Credit AID selected for Visa or Mastercard
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-67-2.constraint: Follow steps to determine DCC eligibility

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-69-3.statement: RQ 4300: Service Code '2xx' and '6xx' must be accepted for Fallback transactions.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-69-3.constraint: Magnetic stripe reader must accept swiped EMV card as non-chip transaction despite Service Code

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-69-4.statement: RQ 4400: Fallback transactions must be identified in the authorization message via POS Entry Mode.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-69-4.constraint: Authorization request POS Entry Mode must indicate EMV Fallback (e.g. '80')

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-7-2.statement: Presence of EMV tags on Quick Chip Transactions is optional.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-70-10.statement: Fallback not allowed if transaction is cancelled at any point; a new transaction may use same payment form.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-70-10.constraint: Another form of payment required; new transaction may reuse same payment form

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-70-2.statement: Effective Jan 15 2021, Empty Candidate List (ECL)/Unknown AID transactions must be coded as Fallback, not Magnetic Stripe (POS entry mode 02).
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-70-2.condition: Chip Card Terminal deployment without end-to-end certification, ECL/Unknown AID transaction
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-70-2.constraint: Code as Fallback instead of Magnetic Stripe (POS entry mode 02)

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-70-4.statement: DCI Network: Fallback Indicator Value is 9 in Data Element 40 (CPTRM) and Data Element 22 Position 7.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-70-5.statement: Fallback processing is not allowed if the chip is blocked by the issuer.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-70-6.statement: Fallback not allowed if chip application is blocked and no additional AIDs exist on the card.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-70-6.condition: Chip application blocked, no additional AIDs

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-70-7.statement: Fallback not allowed if transaction is offline declined (AAC generated at 1st Generate AC).

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-70-8.statement: Fallback not allowed if card is prematurely removed before transaction completion.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-70-9.statement: Fallback not allowed if not supported by a specific payment network, even if enabled globally at device level.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-70-9.condition: Fallback not supported by payment network

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-71-1.statement: Offline Only CATs (Terminal Type 26) must not support MSR or Technical Fallback transactions.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-71-1.constraint: MSR and Technical Fallback not supported

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-71-3.statement: Fallback prompting should only be enabled for 60 seconds.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-71-3.constraint: Enabled for max 60 seconds, then prompt to use chip reader if Service Code '2xx'/'6xx'

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-71-4.statement: Card insert and tap should be supported during Fallback, allowing switch to a different EMV card.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-71-5.statement: Fallback Enable/Disable should be configurable per card scheme (AID).

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-71-6.statement: Cancel Fallback if an EMV card is inserted or tapped while waiting for a Fallback swipe; process as EMV transaction.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-71-6.condition: EMV card inserted/tapped while waiting for Fallback swipe

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-71-7.statement: Cancel Fallback if card swipe Service Code is not '2xx' or '6xx'; process as ordinary magnetic stripe transaction.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-71-7.constraint: Process as ordinary magnetic stripe transaction

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-71-9.statement: EMV tags must be included in the host reversal when generating a reversal for an EMV transaction.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-71-9.constraint: Include EMV tags in host reversal

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-72-11.statement: Incremental authorizations are typically not EMV transactions and do not require chip data.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-72-3.statement: Presence of EMV tags on Quick Chip Transactions is optional.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-72-4.statement: PIN Pad Unavailable reversal reason requires EMV Tags from 1st Generate AC.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-72-5.statement: Transaction Cancelled reversal reason requires EMV Tags from 1st Generate AC.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-72-6.statement: Card Removed reversal reason requires EMV Tags from 1st Generate AC.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-72-7.statement: Chip Error reversal reason requires EMV Tags from 1st Generate AC.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-72-8.statement: For chip malfunction at 2nd Generate AC, MasterCard requires transaction disposition based on host authorization decision.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-72-9.statement: Card Decline reversal reason requires EMV Tags from 2nd Generate AC.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-73-1.statement: Partial Reversals must be sent to the host in keyed format.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-73-1.constraint: sent to the host in keyed format

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-73-2.statement: Incremental authorizations and Partial Reversals must be sent to the host in keyed format, without other original authorization card data.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-73-2.condition: Transaction Type = Incremental Authorization or Partial Reversal
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-73-2.constraint: Must be sent keyed, no EMV tags or original card data included

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-73-3.statement: Initial Authorization request is sent with EMV Tags, entry mode Contact/Contactless.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-73-3.constraint: Entry Mode must be Contact/Contactless, EMV Tags included

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-73-4.statement: Completion/Settlement is sent with EMV Tags from the initial authorization, entry mode Contact/Contactless.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-73-4.constraint: Entry Mode must be Contact/Contactless, EMV Tags from initial authorization included

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-73-5.statement: If chip returns AAC at 1st GENERATE AC for refund, POS must include EMV data with AAC in online refund request.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-73-5.condition: Chip returns AAC (Decline) at 1st GENERATE AC during EMV refund
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-73-5.constraint: POS must include DE 55 chip data with AAC; no 2nd GENERATE AC sent

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-73-6.statement: If chip returns ARQC at 1st GENERATE AC for refund, POS must include EMV data with ARQC and send 2nd GENERATE AC after Issuer response.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-73-6.condition: Chip returns ARQC (Go Online) at 1st GENERATE AC during EMV refund
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-73-6.constraint: POS must include DE 55 chip data with ARQC and send 2nd GENERATE AC with Issuer's response

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-74-1.statement: Credit refund must first submit a refund authorization before settling the transaction.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-74-1.constraint: Refund authorization must be submitted first

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-74-2.statement: Mastercard Refund Authorization requires AAC for Contactless transactions (RQ 4701).

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-74-4.statement: mPOS devices without PIN support cannot be routed to Mastercard Maestro or Visa Interlink networks.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-74-4.condition: mPOS device does not support PIN entry
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-74-4.constraint: Cannot route to Maestro or Interlink; those AIDs cannot be supported

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-74-9.statement: Every card data entry point must force EMV when service code starts with '2' or '6' in mixed EMV/non-EMV POS solutions.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-75-1.statement: Capability for each device at a POS must be able to support EMV.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-75-2.statement: If a card is swiped with Service Code '2xx' or '6xx', the POS must prompt insertion into chip reader.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-75-2.constraint: POS must prompt insert into chip reader; swipe not allowed

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-75-3.statement: All devices in an EMV POS Solution must validate Service Code before allowing swiped transactions.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-75-3.constraint: Devices must not allow swipe without Service Code validation, else must not share chip-capable terminal capability

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-75-4.statement: Cardholder must be prompted to accept lower partial authorization amount before External Authenticate or 2nd Generate AC.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-75-4.constraint: Prompt cardholder to accept lower amount before further EMV processing

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-75-7.statement: Tag 9F02 cannot be changed by the issuer as the chip card does not receive it in the authorization response.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-76-3.statement: EMV transactions should always be sent as dual message/credit requests.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-77-3.statement: Any dual-device/controller solution must have each device support EMV capability for applicable entry mode.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-77-3.condition: Two devices actively support swipe/insert/tap entry modes
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-77-3.constraint: Each device must support EMV capability

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-77-4.statement: Sharing TIDs across EMV and non-EMV devices can impact Liability Shift Chargebacks.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-77-4.condition: EMV capable and non-EMV capable device share same TID
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-77-4.constraint: Non-EMV device should prompt cardholder to use nearby EMV ready device

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-77-5.statement: Pre-authorization transactions must contain the chip data used to generate the cryptogram sent in the authorization request.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-77-5.constraint: Must include relevant chip data for cryptogram generation

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-77-6.statement: Completion transactions must follow the pre-authorization message per industry rules and regulations.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-77-6.constraint: Must follow pre-authorization per industry-specific rules

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-78-1.statement: Completion messages must contain same chip data, POS Entry Mode, and settlement indicator as pre-authorization response.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-78-1.constraint: Must match original chip data, POS Entry Mode, and settlement indicator

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-78-4.statement: EMV offline chip-based authorization is not supported under Quick Chip processing.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-79-3.statement: Mastercard requires CVM results (Tag 9F34) be amended to reflect final outcome, but TVR (Tag 95) must not be amended.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-79-3.condition: Mastercard transaction with amended final amount

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-79-4.statement: POS Solution instance must support either Quick Chip or traditional EMV, not both for a given Brand.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-79-4.constraint: Must support either Quick Chip or traditional, not both

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-79-5.statement: For EMV Level 3 Certification on Mastercard/Visa/Discover, Tag 9F02 should use Final Transaction Amount (recommended) or Placeholder Amount.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-79-5.condition: Terminal supports M/Chip Fast or QuickChip on Contactless interface
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-79-5.constraint: Use Final Transaction Amount (recommended) or updated Placeholder Amount per test case

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-80-1.statement: Merchant/ISV must contact Mastercard directly before testing if 9F02 Provisional amount cannot be changed for testing.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-80-1.condition: 9F02 Provisional amount cannot be changed for testing purposes
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-80-1.constraint: Must contact Mastercard directly before testing begins

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-83-8.statement: Tag 9A (Transaction Date) is used by issuers as a variable in the ARQC algorithm and must reflect actual cardholder transaction date.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-83-8.constraint: Tag 9A must be actual date of cardholder's EMV transaction

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-84-1.statement: EMV offline approved transactions should be uploaded to host periodically throughout the day, not all at settlement.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-84-1.constraint: Upload periodically rather than at settlement

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-86-1.statement: EMV refund must include DE 55 chip data with AAC in online refund request if chip returns AAC decline.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-86-1.condition: Chip returns AAC at 1st GENERATE AC for refund
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-86-1.constraint: POS must include DE 55 chip data with AAC, POS Entry Mode must reflect chip transaction

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-86-2.statement: EMV refund must include DE 55 chip data with ARQC and send 2nd GENERATE AC if chip returns ARQC.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-86-2.condition: Chip returns ARQC at 1st GENERATE AC for refund
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-86-2.constraint: POS must send 2nd GENERATE AC with Issuer response before card removal

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-94-1.statement: All EMV POS Solutions must implement support to download updated CAPK files.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-94-1.constraint: Mandatory support for CAPK file download

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-95-1.statement: EMV POS Solutions must not download CAPK File 'round robin' between the two Data Centers.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-95-1.constraint: Download from a single server/datacenter only

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-95-3.statement: EMV POS Solutions should check for CAPK updates regularly and download as soon as possible.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-96-4.statement: Client must determine CAPK installation process for each device before implementing EMV in production.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-96-4.constraint: Determine status request/update process per device, possibly with terminal vendor

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-98-1.statement: Merchant ID (MID) must be truncated if present on EMV receipt.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-98-2.statement: Terminal ID (TID) must be truncated if present on EMV receipt.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-98-4.statement: Magnetic stripe swipe receipt mandates have not changed and are not documented in this manual.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-98-4.constraint: Refer to Payment Brand or merchant specs

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-98-5.statement: Mandates to print or not print receipts have not changed with EMV implementation.
